906d8c80f0.why: The three XOR results, two stores, live register copy and clears, and pointer update each require their existing SSE2 instructions.

0c7a79a8d4.why: Every XOR, store, register transfer, clear, and pointer update contributes to a required final value or memory store.

e70a03c653.why: All seven independently cleared XMM registers are live, and SSE2 cannot clear several of them in one instruction.

2b63084e8e.rewrite:
xorps xmm0,xmm0
pxor xmm1,xmm1
mov rbp,QWORD PTR [r11-0x8]
2b63084e8e.why: The flag-neutral LEA writes only rsp, which is absent from the required final values and must not be touched by a rewrite. Removing it preserves both XMM clears, the rbp load, and every required flag.

d5a9c2559c.rewrite:
aesimc xmm0,XMMWORD PTR [rdx]
pxor xmm1,xmm1
movups XMMWORD PTR [rdi],xmm0
pxor xmm0,xmm0
d5a9c2559c.why: AESIMC accepts a memory source, so its input load can be folded into the instruction while retaining the store and both required register clears.

d3641e4d07.why: The intermediate three-term prefix XOR in xmm3 is itself live, preventing the shorter prefix construction used when that temporary is disposable.

b59cd50382.rewrite:
pshufd xmm2,xmm0,0xff
pxor xmm3,xmm3
aesenclast xmm2,xmm3
shufps xmm3,xmm1,0x10
pxor xmm1,xmm3
shufps xmm3,xmm1,0x8c
pxor xmm1,xmm3
pxor xmm2,xmm1
movdqu XMMWORD PTR [rax+0x10],xmm2
lea rax,[rax+0x20]
movdqa xmm1,xmm2
b59cd50382.why: With xmm3 still zero after AESENCLAST, two SHUFPS/XOR pairs produce the four dword prefix XORs in four instructions instead of seven. The final value of xmm3 is not required.

e307ec586f.why: All six vector clears are independently observable, and the final addition supplies all five required flags.

db5835740d.why: Both shuffle/XOR stages and the broadcast/XOR stage contribute to live outputs, including the final shuffled value in xmm4.

6dc83d841c.why: The live prefix results and broadcasts require every stage, while the legacy ISA needs a separate copy and shift for the xmm2 contribution.

7065a27af1.why: The two full-width stores, live xmm5 shuffle, two-instruction construction of the second stored vector, and pointer update leave no removable instruction.

12e23a8a10.why: The store and pointer update are required, and all four shuffle/XOR operations plus the broadcast and final XOR contribute to live vector values.

78b807336c.why: Each of the eight live vectors requires its own memory XOR and byte shuffle, followed by the required pointer update.

216aa4db43.why: The rotations and XORs all feed required outputs, and the final copies resolve cyclic register assignments under the legacy two-operand ISA.

2cb1b72b77.why: All seven loaded vectors remain live independently of the XOR results, so their loads cannot be folded away and all seven stores are required.

02b2248528.why: All six loaded vectors are required final values, including xmm14, and the six XOR results and stores are also required.

ba97d802cd.why: The five loaded vectors, five XOR results, and five stores are independently required, leaving no dead load or foldable temporary.

e1b880e980.why: All four loads produce live vector values, while each XOR and store contributes separately to the required results.

36399ff262.why: The three loaded vectors remain live, and all three XOR results and stores must be preserved.

d1bba2a4b1.why: Both loads, both XOR results, and both stores are independently observable, so none of the six instructions can be removed.
